name: Caviar / Fish Roe
imageAlt: premium red and black fish roe
description: Fish roe (caviar) is an elite, concentrated marine superfood characterized by a magnificent lipid profile and high protein density. Its botanical-like concentration of pre-formed Omega-3 fatty acids (EPA/DHA), Vitamin D, and Choline is engineered to optimize cognitive velocity, mitigate systemic inflammatory cytokines, and reinforce cellular membrane plasticity.
macroIntro: A nutrient-dense, ultra-low carbohydrate architecture featuring significant bioavailable animal protein and premium, essential fatty acid matrices.
microIntro: A spectacular micronutrient profile presenting elite yields of lipid-soluble vitamins, B-complex groups, and rare marine trace minerals.

Systemic Anti-Inflammation: Marine Omega-3s optimize eicosanoid balance, suppressing pro-inflammatory pathways.
Vascular Shielding: Lipid profiles enhance HDL dynamics and support endothelial nitric oxide pathways.
Hematopoiesis: Vitamin B12 and heme iron synergistically accelerate erythrocyte replication and oxygen transport.

precautionsIntro: Nutritional management regarding sodium, purines, and food safety:
precautions: Sodium Concentration: Brined roe contains high sodium; hypertensive patients and individuals with CKD must restrict intake.
Purine Content: Purines increase systemic uric acid; individuals with gout or uric acid-related lithiasis should avoid excessive consumption.
Biological Risk: Raw/unpasteurized roe carries a risk of *Listeria*; pregnant and immunocompromised individuals should prioritize pasteurized variants.
